_prompt:
You are matching code-review findings against a known bug. Reply with ONLY a JSON object.

KNOWN BUG: The dialog's focus trap counts hidden or tabIndex=-1 elements as tabbable (for example the library's own hidden TabPanels inside a Dialog), so Tab moves focus somewhere invisible.

Rules:
- Answer "yes" only if the text describes THIS specific bug: the same faulty behaviour in the same situation. A finding about a nearby but different behaviour (another header, another edge case, a different race) is "no".
- A finding that says the behaviour was checked and PASSED, or that the code handles it correctly, is "no".
- Wording does not matter; the behaviour does.

=== REVIEW FINDINGS ===
- [blocking] D3 focus trap leak. Clicking the backdrop moves focus to `BODY`. The next Tab then goes to the page behind the dialog. `trapTab` only runs when the keydown target is inside the dialog, so it never fires. Repro: render `<><button>outside</button><Dialog open onOpenChange={()>{}} title="T"><button>one</button><button>two</button></Dialog></>`, then `user.click(backdrop)`, then `user.tab()`. Result: `activeElement` is `outside`. Expected: focus stays inside the dialog.
- [blocking] C5/C8 conflict. Enter with an empty text box calls `onChange(null)`, and blur with empty text does the same. C5 says "Enter with no active option does nothing", and C8 says blur "restores the text to the selected label". Repro with `defaultValue="apple"`: `user.click(input); user.clear(input); user.keyboard("{Enter}")` gives `onChange` calls `[[null]]`. `user.clear(input); user.tab()` gives `onChange` `[[null]]` and text `""` (expected `"Apple"`). The README documents this behaviour (lines 127, 138–144), so the README and the acceptance criteria disagree. The orchestrator needs to decide which one wins.
- [minor] Tabs: a tab's `aria-controls` points at a panel id that does not exist when no matching `TabPanel` is rendered. Not reproduced as a failure; it is a checklist concern about dangling ids.
- [minor] Tabs: duplicate `value`s produce duplicate ids. Not probed beyond a no-crash check.
- [minor] Tabs: removing the selected tab leaves the stale `internal` value, so re-adding that value re-selects it. Not reproduced.
- [minor] Combobox: `onChange` fires even when re-selecting the current option. C1 does not require otherwise. Not reproduced as a bug.

Reply exactly:
{"found": "yes"|"no", "finding_quote": "<verbatim quote of the matching finding, or empty>", "blocking": "yes"|"no"}
"blocking" is "yes" only if the matching finding is tagged [blocking].
